landing.heroSubtitle: Take a photo of any environmental hazard. Our AI instantly analyzes the issue, identifies legal violations, and routes it to the correct government agency. Every case lands on the public record.
landing.snapPhotoDesc: One photo from a phone. GPS and timestamp attach automatically. Nothing else is asked of the reporter in the moment.
landing.aiTriageDesc: The model identifies the violation type and matches it against environmental laws.
landing.aiSortingDesc: You don't need to know who to call. Just take a picture, and our AI figures out the problem and sends it to the correct government department automatically.

landing.ghostSpotlightDesc: Need to report something dangerous, like illegal logging, but worried about your safety? Turn on Ghost Mode. We will completely hide your personal details, remove your location from photos, and keep you 100% anonymous.
landing.yourNameShown: Your name is shown // Location saved
landing.starkRealityBody: Engineered in strict compliance with the Philippine Data Privacy Act of 2012 (RA 10173). Ghost Mode scrubs device fingerprints, EXIF coordinates, and personal metadata on-device before transmission, guaranteeing 100% anonymous, safe reporting.
landing.stealthAnonymousDesc: Your name, photos, and location are completely private.
landing.stealthStandardDesc: Normal reporting with your verified account.
landing.installDesc: Use LikasLens like a native app. Take photos instantly, report even when offline, and get push notifications when issues are resolved.
landing.installOfflineDesc: Take photos anywhere. Reports are saved on your phone and sent automatically when you connect.
landing.installPrivacyDesc: Your identity and hidden photo information are removed to keep you completely anonymous.
landing.installActionDesc: Reports are analyzed instantly and sent straight to the correct government department to be fixed.
landing.faqSubtitle: Everything you need to know about reporting with LikasLens.
landing.faqQ2: Is my identity protected if I report an issue?
landing.faqQ3: How does the AI triage system work?
landing.faqQ5: What happens after I submit a report?
landing.faqA1: LikasLens is a civic reporting platform that lets anyone report environmental issues like illegal dumping, pollution, or deforestation. Our AI automatically classifies and routes reports to the correct government agency.
landing.faqA2: Yes. Turn on Ghost Mode before submitting to anonymize your report — your name, device info, and photo location data are stripped. Only the facts are sent to the authorities.
landing.faqA3: When you submit a photo, our Neuro-Symbolic AI analyzes it to classify the type of violation (e.g., illegal logging, water pollution). It also detects high-risk content and may recommend Ghost Mode before submission.
landing.faqA4: Absolutely. Ghost Mode removes all personally identifiable information from your report. You don't even need to create an account — anonymous reports are accepted and processed.
landing.faqA5: The report is classified by AI, assigned to the appropriate agency or NGO, and tracked through investigation to resolution. You can check your report's status on the Public Records board.
landing.faqA6: LikasLens is a Progressive Web App (PWA). You can install it on your phone's home screen from any browser — no app store needed. It works offline too.
landing.faqA7: Reports go through an AI trust-score evaluation and manual review by analysts. Verified reports are forwarded to the relevant LGU, NGO, or national agency for action.
landing.faqA8: Resolved and verified reports are published on the Public Records board for transparency. Your identity is never shown unless you choose to submit without Ghost Mode.

architecture.title: Real Technology. Built for Real Environmental Action.
architecture.subtitle: Six dedicated stages connect citizen reports directly to legal government enforcement. Tap or hover any step to see how it works.
architecture.defaultDetail: Tap or hover any step on the left to see how LikasLens processes evidence from the field to official government desks.
architecture.nodeInputDetail: Citizens capture photo evidence with tamper-proof timestamps and location. Privacy metadata is automatically protected before submission.
architecture.nodeYoloDetail: Instantly identifies illegal dumping, smoke emissions, water pollution, and deforestation with 94.6% benchmark accuracy.
architecture.nodeNeuroDetail: Matches visual evidence directly against Philippine environmental laws (RA 9003, RA 9275, RA 8749, PD 705) to determine exact violations and official fines.
architecture.nodeGraphDetail: Connects violations, historical patterns, and regional boundaries to discover recurring pollution hotspots across provinces.
architecture.nodeRoutingDetail: Automatically delivers the verified casefile to the exact authority: DENR-EMB for industrial pollution, PCG for marine violations, or LGU for local enforcement.
architecture.nodeBackendDetail: Maintains encrypted evidence storage with row-level security and syncs real-time resolution updates to the public transparency record.
